title: Swap Numbers
statement: Given two integers a and b, swap their values and return the pair in swapped order.
think: What is the task asking? Exchange the values of two variables.
What is the key operation? Store one value temporarily, then assign in reverse order.
What wording signals stand out? Swap, exchange values.
Which pattern fits? Basic step-by-step logic / linear operations.
What is the brute force idea? A temporary variable is already the clearest solution.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a temp variable or tuple swap in C#.
What are the edge cases? Equal numbers, negative values.
What is the complexity? O(1) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I keep one value in a temp variable, assign the second to the first, then write temp into the second.
interview: I would swap the values using a temporary variable because it is the clearest and safest approach.
ru: Самый понятный способ — сохранить одно число во временную переменную, потом поменять значения местами.

critical: Overwrite one value before saving it
nice: Do not mention tuple swap as a C# alternative

gaps: Important: understand simple variable reassignment order
whyThisPattern: This is a fundamentals logic task based on a few ordered assignments.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because there is no mapping.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no sequence traversal.
